# AT-Switch v3.15.2

> 发布候选：安装包已更新，等待本次原生平台验收记录齐备后发布。

发布日期 / Release date: 2026-10-05

## 本次更新

- 新增腾讯 ima，支持 macOS 与 Windows，切换「问问 ima」和「我的 copilot」的默认模型。
- 首次连接使用本机已登录账号；经确认将 Provider 地址、API Key 和模型名保存到该腾讯 ima 账号。
- 保存账号隔离的加密恢复基线，分别校验远端首选与本地选择；重复切换复用管理模型并保留用户原有模型。
- 优化 Windows 正常退出与重启，避免“ima 未正确关闭”提示；未运行时切换、恢复均不额外启动。
- 恢复原始配置后，AT Switch 新建的模型项保留为未选中以便复用。

使用前先安装并登录 ima，再刷新 Agent 状态。ima 仅支持公网 OpenAI Chat Completions 接口，不支持 localhost、私网或 AT Switch 本地代理。重启前保存工作，完成后在两个入口新建会话验证。切换 ima 账号后重新刷新并连接。

## Changes

- Add Tencent ima on macOS and Windows, switching default models in Ask ima and My copilot.
- Connect the locally signed-in account with consent to save the provider URL, API key, and model name in that Tencent ima account.
- Keep encrypted, account-scoped restoration checkpoints; verify remote preferences and local choices separately, reuse the managed model, and preserve existing user models.
- Quit and restart ima normally on Windows without incorrect-shutdown prompts. Keep it stopped when switching or restoring while it is not running.
- Restoration leaves the AT Switch-created model unselected for reuse.

Install and sign in to ima, then refresh Agent status. Use a public OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint. Localhost, private-network endpoints, and the AT Switch local proxy are unsupported. Save work before restarting, verify both entry points in new conversations, and reconnect after changing ima accounts.

## 验证 / Validation

产品源码 5c05309。189 项 Rust、107 项前端测试，Windows/macOS CI、GTK 宏回归和依赖审计通过。真实账号 DeepSeek、GLM 的重复切换、未运行时切换及恢复测试通过，并保留已有模型。

Product source: 5c05309. 189 Rust and 107 frontend tests, Windows/macOS CI, GTK macro regressions and dependency audits pass. Real-account DeepSeek and GLM roundtrips cover repeated switches, stopped-app behavior and restoration while preserving existing models.

## 安全修复 / Security fixes

rustls 升级至 0.23.45，修复 [RUSTSEC-2026-0285](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0285)。Tauri 升级至 2.12.1，移除五项停止维护的 unic 依赖；GTK 编译宏移植上游诊断实现，移除 proc-macro-error。Rust 全锁文件审计无问题，npm 生产依赖审计为 0 vulnerabilities；没有忽略公告或降低严重等级。

Rustls 0.23.45 fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0285. Tauri 2.12.1 removes five unmaintained unic dependencies; upstream GTK macro diagnostic backports remove proc-macro-error. Whole-lock Rust advisory checks and production npm audit pass, without advisory exceptions or severity downgrades.

## ima 重复模型修复 / ima duplicate-model fix

修复账号已有相同目标模型时的切换冲突。优先复用地址、密钥、模型名及输入输出额度完全一致的配置，保留已有模型、原始选择和失败回滚能力。

Reuse an existing exact endpoint, credential, model-name and token-limit match to avoid duplicate-model conflicts. Preserve existing models, original selections and rollback behavior.

官网与 GitHub 使用同一批安装包。The website and GitHub use identical files.

Mac 使用 Developer ID 正式签名与公证包。Windows 安装器按现有发布约定不签名，可能出现下载或安装警告；请核对 SHA-256。
